text_block_list.text:
Since Almond Eye wasn't feeling well, we 
headed over to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... It is what it is! I'll get plenty 
of rest and make a comeback as soon as 
possible!

text_block_list.name: Q-Maru
text_block_list.text:
"—Hello, Eye-chan. Looks like you've 
wandered into this world."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Kyumaru!? That must mean... This is 
Kyumaru Village!?

text_block_list.name: Q-Maru
text_block_list.text:
"To return to our original world, we must 
gather all the legendary cucumbers that 
exist in this world. For that reason—I 
need you to come on a journey with me."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
An adventure... with Kyumaru!? Alright, 
let's go!

text_block_list.name: First Guardian
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, the legendary cucumber really is 
just past here! But there's no way I'm 
budging!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Hey. Do you want to go over there and 
play with the ball for a bit?

text_block_list.name: First Guardian
text_block_list.text: Huh?! I'll do it, I'll do it!

text_block_list.name: Q-Maru
text_block_list.text:
“Nice, Eye-chan. While they're 
distracted—”

text_block_list.name: Second Guardian
text_block_list.text:
A legendary cucumber? Never heard of it. A 
golden cucumber with two kappa marks 
carved on it? Like I'd know about――

text_block_list.name: Second Guardian
text_block_list.text: Wait, so you DO know!

text_block_list.name: Second Guardian
text_block_list.text:
"...Not that I'm gonna tell ya where it's 
hidden. Like I'd ever blab that it's 
behind that rock over there—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Behind that rock over there?! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Second Guardian
text_block_list.text:
...Wait till I make the comeback line, 
will ya?

text_block_list.name: Third Guardian
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! A girl and a kappa on a journey to 
return to their original world?! What a 
wonderful setup!

text_block_list.name: Third Guardian
text_block_list.text:
Then... uuum... what role should I play?! 
The Demon King!? A wicked witch!? What 
should I do!?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Honestly, just handing it over 
normally would be the most helpful, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Q-Maru
text_block_list.text:
"—All the legendary cucumbers have been 
gathered. If you head in the direction the 
tips of the cucumbers are pointing, you 
will be able to return to your original 
world."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Still... Kyumaru. I suppose this is 
goodbye.

text_block_list.name: Q-Maru
text_block_list.text:
"Our adventures together were so much fun. 
...Please, whenever you bite into a 
cucumber, remember me..."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I'll never forget you! When I get back to 
the other side, I'm going to munch on tons 
of cucumbers!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...... A dream, huh? I wish I could've 
stayed with Q-maru a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Still... I'll do my best in my own world! 
With the promise of the cucumber in my 
heart, I'll run once again.

And—when Almond Eye returned from the 
infirmary, she had somehow broken out of 
her shell and was safely back in high 
spirits.
